subject: Temporary capacity bucket & invoice smoothing request
messages:
From: Sarah Huang <sarah@opswing.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Opswing Procurement <procurement@opswing.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Hi Diego —

Quick context: we're ramping an A/B test next week that could spike tokens for ~72 hours. Our forecast shows a concentrated surge (est. 120–200M tokens) between Apr 20–23. We want to avoid hard throttles that would break the experiment.

Two asks:
1) Can Redwood provision a short-term burst bucket (one-week window) that we can draw from instead of changing our committed tier?
2) If we do draw it, can you smooth the invoicing so the overrun is either blended into the month or invoiced as a one-line true-up instead of multiple line-item overages? Opswing is working with a fixed monthly budget and PO cadence, so minimizing invoice complexity helps.

We'd consider a small premium vs. our committed rate if there is a cleaner billing path. Attaching a short projection and our PO template.

Thanks — appreciate any quick guidance so we can decide on whether to throttle the test.

— Sarah
Sarah Huang
Head of Product Operations, Opswing
attachment: opswing_usage_projection.csv (spreadsheet stub)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah@opswing.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and the projection — this is exactly the kind of short-term surge we built the burst flow for. High level: yes, we can do a temporary burst bucket and offer a single true-up invoice. A few clarifying points so I can get finance and legal to sign off quickly:

- Window: you asked Apr 20–23; we typically set a 7-day window to be safe. Confirm you only need Apr 20–23 or the full Apr 20–26 window.
- Size: your projection top-end is ~200M tokens. Do you want us to provision a 200M token bucket or a 150M bucket with the option to auto-escalate if you hit 90%?
- Rate & smoothing: we can offer a blended burst rate rather than separate per-token overrun line items. For this account, I can propose a 20% uplift over your committed per-1k-token rate for any tokens consumed from the burst bucket, and we will roll that into one true-up invoice dated at the end of the month. Finance needs the PO before we ship the bucket.
- Credits if unused: we can offer a partial credit (20% of unused bucket value) back to your next invoice if <40% of the bucket is used.

I'll loop in Marissa and Priyom to confirm the numbers and get legal/finance notes. If that sounds reasonable, Sarah, send the PO and I'll prepare a short one-page amendment.

Best,
Diego
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachment: opswing_burst_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal stub)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Diego —

Reviewed. A couple of operational items from finance ops side:
- We can do a one-off 7-day burst bucket and invoice as a single true-up.
- Pricing: Priyom suggests a 25% uplift on the committed rate for short-window buckets under 7 days to cover scheduling overhead and priority capacity. However, for strategic customers we can cap the uplift at 20% if sales commits to a visible post-launch usage review.
- PO requirement: finance requires the PO to reference the amendment "Burst Bucket Addendum (OPSW)" and the deal id to match our HubSpot record.
- Reporting: we will provide a single usage invoice line with a CSV usage export attached; Opswing can accept that as the one-line true-up.

If you want the 20% uplift we should get a short note from Sarah committing to a usage review next week — that satisfies the commercial concession guardrail.

— Priyom
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah@opswing.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Opswing Procurement <procurement@opswing.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Hi Sarah —

Quick update from our side after internal review:

Proposal we can execute quickly (7-day window):
- Burst bucket: 175,000,000 tokens available Apr 20–26 (drawdown up to 7 days).
- Pricing: 20% uplift on your committed per-1k-token rate for tokens consumed from the burst bucket. This will be invoiced as a single true-up line on your May invoice with an attached CSV export.
- Unused credit: if less than 40% of the bucket is used, we will apply a 20% credit of the unused bucket value to your next invoice.
- PO & amendment: we need a PO that references "Burst Bucket Addendum (OPSW)" and the HubSpot deal id OPSW-2026-04-BURST. I can prepare the one-page amendment and send for e-sign.

If Opswing is comfortable with the 175M bucket at 20% uplift, please send the PO by Apr 18 EOD and I'll push the bucket live the morning of Apr 20.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you covered.

Diego
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Huang <sarah@opswing.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Opswing Procurement <procurement@opswing.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2026 08:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Thanks Diego — appreciate the clarity. Opswing accepts the 175M token bucket for Apr 20–26 and the 20% uplift.

We will send the PO referencing "Burst Bucket Addendum (OPSW)" and OPSW-2026-04-BURST by Apr 18 EOD. Note: procurement will include our standard payment terms (Net 45) — please let me know if that is acceptable or if finance needs Net 30 for true-up invoices.

We also commit to a usage review with Redwood the week after the burst (Apr 27–30) to discuss longer-term capacity.

— Sarah
Head of Product Operations, Opswing

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Huang <sarah@opswing.ai>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Opswing Procurement <procurement@opswing.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2026 17:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-window capacity + invoice smoothing for launch

Perfect — thanks Sarah. Net 45 is fine for this one-off true-up; finance confirms.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) I'll upload the one-page "Burst Bucket Addendum (OPSW)" to DocuSign and share the link by EOD Apr 19.
2) Once we receive the PO, we'll provision the 175M token bucket and send a confirmation email with the drawdown endpoint and monitoring link.
3) We'll schedule a 30-minute post-burst usage review Apr 28 to go over consumption, cost profile, and longer-term packaging.

Attachments: opswing_burst_proposal_v1.pdf; opswing_po_template.docx

— Diego
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
